text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United States despatches F-117 Stealth fighters and four B-52 bombers to prepare for an attacK on Iraq.
- President Suharto, at the official opening of the 28th ASEAN economic ministers meeting, says World Trade Organisation should concentrate on concrete trade issues.
- ASEAN member countries poised to enter a new stage of greater economic integration.
- Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Sarawak is shelving a M$7 billion steel project to avoid mistakes of Perwaja Steel.
- Electricity pricing mechanism by power suppliers in Singapore will be tried out soon.
- London-based Thistle Hotels will sell 211.6 million shares at between 170 pence and 210 pence.
- Port of Singapore Authority would take significant stake to develop a US$200 million mini-city in Burma if studies show viable.
- Sinar Mas group raising US$500 million through biggest bond issue in Asia in order to reduce reliance on G-7 currencies trading.
- Mauritian businessman Roland Maurel promises to return by end of the month Amcol Holdings' US$39.6 million investment from aborted joint venture property development.
- News of increased housing supplies and private sector participation in executive condominium market fails to dent listed property stocks.
